title: Epic: wolfHSM backend full PKCS#11 integration
description:
Wire the wolfHSM crypto dispatch layer (hsm_sign/verify/decrypt/derive — already implemented in src/wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c) into the wolfP11 PKCS#11 slot/session model so applications can use a wolfHSM server as a PKCS#11 token without code changes.

Currently the backend is orphaned: the four crypto functions are solid but there is no WP11_PROTO_WOLFHSM slot type, no C_Login path to establish a whClientContext, no slot created at C_Initialize, no key provisioning path, and no tests. Once integrated, wolfP11 should expose a wolfHSM server as one or more PKCS#11 slots, load pre-provisioned server keys at login time, and (optionally) generate or import keys on the server.

Scope includes:
- Slot model (WP11_PROTO_WOLFHSM, wp11_slot_t extension, C_Initialize)
- Session lifecycle (C_Login connects to server; C_Logout disconnects)
- Key discovery (enumerate pre-provisioned server keys into g_keys[] at login)
- C_GenerateKeyPair on server
- C_ImportKey (DER → server, get key ID back)
- Test suite with loopback / SHM transport

Out of scope: wolfHSM server setup and provisioning tools; OpenSSL provider integration; key wrapping (C_WrapKey/C_UnwrapKey).
